{{Description|"The sly Goblins excel at making the best possible deals and bargains. Affiliating yourself with the Goblin faction will offer you economic opportunities and allows you to benefit from larger quantities of everything."}}<ref>Note: the in-game flavor text refers to the very early versions of goblin and has not been changed since. Goblin no longer has upgrades to help reduce the price of buildings, aside from the bloodline, which is available to all factions. Goblin's current focus is on faction coin generation.</ref>

== The Goblin Faction ==
[[File:Goblin champion trophy.png|left|54x54px|Goblin Champion Trophy]]
[[File:Greed_Drive.png|right|Greed Drive]]
Part of the original Evil [[Vanilla Factions]], the '''Goblin''''s asset is the ability to [[Buildings|build]] cheap, thus allowing you to build more. Their Bloodline is valuable when aiming for all the [[Trophies#Building Trophies|building trophy series]].
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Evil'''''
* [[Alignment#Leges|'''Leges''']]: '''''Balance'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Goblin's Greed''''' - Instantly produces [[Faction Coins]] based on the amount of [[Gems]] you own. Also increases the production of all buildings based on the amount of Faction Coins found in this game for 5 seconds.<br />''FC'' {{Formula|\left\lfloor\ln^3(1 + x) + 20\right\rfloor|your current gems}}<br />''Production'' {{Formula|stat|0.75 \times \ln^{3.15}(1 + x)%|your Faction Coins Gained (This Game)}}
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': '''''Greed Drive''''' - Goblin's Greed costs 150 less [[mana]].
** Unlock requirement: Cast a chain of 100 Goblin's Greeds in a single game. The chain is interrupted by casting different spells. <br /><sup>''Note: Spell casts from the [[Goblin#Tier 3 Upgrades|Goblin Central Bank]] upgrade do not count toward or interfere with getting this trophy.''</sup>  
* '''[[Heritage]]''': Increase the production of all buildings based on the amount of gems you own. <br />{{Formula|\left\lfloor7.5 * \log(1 + x)\right\rfloor%|the amount of gems you have}}
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Reduce all building cost multipliers. <br />{{MultiplierReduction|0.02|1.13|1.15}}
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Avarice Drive''''' - Increase Goblin's Greed spell duration by 5 seconds.  
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Research Building]]''':  '''''Goblin Bank''''' (from Witch Conclaves)  
* '''[[Research#Research#The Facilities & Related Factions|Research Facility]]''': '''''Economics'''''  
* '''[[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''':  '''''Slave Markets''''' (from Slave Pens)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': None (All Vanilla Factions are enabled by default)

== Unique Buildings ==
[[File:Goblin_Unique_Building_Design.png|thumb|left]] 
[[File:Special-building-goblin.png|right]]
[[File:Slave Market.png|right]]
At R16, the Goblin's ''Witch Conclaves'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Goblin Bank''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests.

At R100, the Goblin's ''Slave Pens'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Slave Markets''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.{{Clr}}

== Goblin Research ==
[[File:Research-new-progress-system-msg.PNG|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R16, the game advisor tells us that the Vanilla factions have gained tremendous power. Their power can be ours if we get ready and seek them again. 

To unlock Goblin research, play the Goblin faction and simply follow the appearing quests (Do not [[prestige]]). These can be done in separate game plays.
